title: Red Hat Security Advisory: freerdp security update
description: Multiple denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in FreeRDP, a free implementation of the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The flaws include uninitialized progressive tile handling, a heap-based buffer overflow during MP3 audio decoding, and a heap out-of-bounds write in NTLM authentication. These issues affect the freerdp client used to connect to various RDP servers. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing these vulnerabilities in their Enterprise Linux 9.4 Update Services for SAP Solutions.
